name: American BBQ: Spicy Cinnamon and Chilli Chocolate Brownies
description: Dark chocolate brownies spiced with chilli and cinnamon, baked in a 9x9 inch pan at 180°C on the BBQ kettle or in a hot BBQ.
recipeIngredient: 150 g unsalted butter, plus extra for greasing

itemListElement.text: Adjust the dampers on your kettle to bring the temperature to 180°C, or pre-heat your BBQ to hot.
Melt the chocolate and butter in a bowl over a pot of boiling water with the ground chilli, cinnamon, vanilla and salt, stirring occasionally. Set aside to cool.
Line a 9 x 9 inch (23 x 23 cm) metal baking pan with parchment paper and lightly grease with butter.
In a mixing bowl, combine the melted chocolate mixture with the sugar. When combined, add the eggs and mix until smooth, then fold in the flour and the chilli flakes. Transfer to the baking pan.
Bake until the brownies feel firm and a paring knife poked into the centre comes out clean (a few crumbs should still stick), about 30 minutes.

Using the parchment lip, lift the brownies from the pan and cool completely. (Chef's tip: to greatly improve texture and flavour, wrap the slab in plastic and let it sit for several hours or overnight at room temperature.)
